lead_raw_text:
The structure of Yb4B8C4 (reduced formula YbBC2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows B centers with two C neighbors at 1.524 Å, C centers with six neighbors (two B, one C, three Yb), and Yb centers with eight neighbors (three B, five C). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between 6-vertex C polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between 6-vertex C and 8-vertex Yb polyhedra.
